newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Overseas visitors exceed 1.5 mln in Nov year - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: Overseas visitors exceed 1.5 mln in Nov year - SNZ.

text.p: The annual number of overseas visitor arrivals to New Zealand exceeded 1.5 million for the first time in the November year, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
During the year, overseas visitor arrivals totalled 1.51 million, up nine percent on the November 1995 year total of 1.39 million.
Visitor arrivals for the month of November rose 10 percent to 149,140 in November 1996, from 135,020 in November 1995. This compares with a three percent increase between November 1994 and 1995.
In seasonally adjusted terms, the number of overseas visitor arrivals rose five percent between October and November 1996, following a one percent drop between September and October.

SNZ said also continuing to rise was the number of New Zealanders going on short trips overseas. During November New Zealand residents left for 90,720 short trips overseas, an increase of 20 percent on the previous November total of 75,570.
In contrast, net migration gains were decreasing. There was a net gain of 2,080 permanent and long term migrants in November, compared with a net gain of 2,870 in November 1995.
The net gain for the year to November was 25,500, down nine percent over the November 1995 year net gain of 28,170.
